reviews.text: Excellent practice. I wish I could give it 100 stars. The doctor is excellent, and she saved my kitten's life. I can't thank her enough. It's truly an excellent practice. Everyone is very helpful, kind, and truly AWESOME.
Wonderful experience. Dr. Barbagallo is thorough, she follows the problem step by step, and it's exactly what I was looking for for my Chicco. I'm really happy.

Dr. Lucia Barbagallo should be cloned! Finding a professional with such professional expertise and such profound humanity is truly rare. She puts her heart into everything she does, and it shows in the way she handles every situation. She's loving with animals and shows sensitivity and kindness towards their owners: this makes her unique. Every time I go, I feel understood and reassured, and when I call, I always get a prompt and thorough response. 🔝

EAN & DANA ARE ALWAYS IN PERFECT SHAPE THANKS TO DOCTOR LUCIA BARBAGALLO.
EAN IS 11 AND DANA IS 9... AMAZING
Experienced and competent veterinarian

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Lucia Barbagallo and all her staff for treating my George and supporting and comforting me over this past year, with professionalism and great humanity, especially in the final and most painful moment. Thank you ❤️
Excellent.  The doctor was very sociable, kind and offered alot of info regarding my pets needs.  Highly recommended
Highly recommended. Very good, kind, sweet doctors who truly love our loved ones. Always available. The staff is also very good.

Beyond the clinical aspects, what I find unacceptable is the complete lack of communication and clarity. When you entrust an animal to a professional, you expect transparency, explanations, and respect: elements that were unfortunately lacking in this experience.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire practice for caring for my sick cat. A big hug to Dr. Lucia for getting my cat back after it escaped from its carrier.
Beautiful people and great professionals.

I have known Dr. Barbagallo for 8 years now (how long, my goodness!)... for us she is Lucia, Lucia who 8 years ago lovingly took care of Vicky, allowing her to spend her last years peacefully and without pain... Lucia who welcomed the arrival of Sophie, our other great love, with us and who takes care of her with us... ❤️

I can only recommend Dr. Barbagallo and her entire staff!
I needed the doctor for my kitten, who sadly passed away too soon, but I was immediately struck by her humanity and helpfulness.
That's not a given, especially when you're also dealing with bad news.

If I could, it would be zero. Aside from waiting a month for a document to submit to the insurance company...never had one. I bring the dog to them and they charge me €100 for a visit and a mycologist. In the meantime, they tell me to use bleach on the dog. Excellent. Today, after 10 days, the dog is almost dying, probably due to an immune system disease that triggered very severe dermatitis (unfortunately, I can't prove that the bleach made the situation worse). The mycologist's result? I had it today and it's "weakly positive"...what? How does this help with the diagnosis and treatment? Embarrassing.
They're really kind and very knowledgeable, and they truly love animals. They've always been my go-to.

My go-to doctor for over ten years for two cats and two dogs.
Always competent, kind, and available.

I met Dr. Lucia and her colleagues at a very difficult time for my dog, Elsa (a 15-year-old she-wolf), and an emotionally difficult time for me.
Even though she wasn't my veterinarian, she welcomed my dog ​​and me with openness and professionalism.
Unfortunately, there was no curative treatment for Elsa. Dr. Lucia was gentle and loving in supporting me as I accompanied Elsa into her eternal sleep.
I thank Dr. Lucia and her staff.
Simona Citi
Lucia is always available, professional, friendly and takes care of our dear furry friends with love and passion.

I recently visited Dr. Barbagallo's office and received a warm welcome.
My puppy also received excellent care, and the problem he had was resolved quickly.
Recommended
Very good and prepared, recommended

Terrible clinic, incompetent staff, as they kept questioning what they had to say and what they were going to give me for the dog's treatment. Plus, they were letting me leave without a receipt, pretending to forget it. €130 just for a vaccine!! And €80 for heartworm pills. Pure madness!!! They told me over the phone that the rabies vaccine cost €50.

Honesty and kindness.
It's hard to find such caring, competent, and approachable vets.
Congratulations!!!!!!!

Lucia is a fantastic doctor. She welcomed us with a smile and extraordinary empathy. We came from Switzerland to have my 8-year-old red Labrador retriever operated on for a malignant sarcoma. He was pampered and cared for by the entire staff, fantastic people from Silvia, her sister, to the doctor herself and her sweet assistants. Thank you for the support, even over the phone, you always give us. I recommend her practice, it's excellent ❤️

Very well equipped veterinary practice, super clean and comfortable, great attention to animals, high professionalism, very polite staff, always available, I recommend trying it
